response.text:
Yes, you can still object. The deadline is Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

- The contribution notice from Muster BKK is dated Thu 10 Sep 2026 [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba]. Ordnung treats it as delivered on Mon 14 Sep 2026. The one-month objection period then ends on the date above [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- To be safe, post a written objection by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. You can also file it electronically or in person at Muster BKK.
- An objection does not suspend payment. After the deadline the notice becomes final.
- This is not legal advice. If you are unsure, consider getting advice.

You can prepare the objection under "Draft letter" in Ordnung.
